scope: Tang Chung Ling Ancestral Hall’s three principal halls and two open courtyards at Lung Yeuk Tau, Fanling, with their linked exterior enclosure and ornamental Cantonese tile roofs.

originalReview.notes: Shows the dark brick front, central entry and bars, broad tile slope, and painted decorative ridge and end brackets.
